title: Carlos De Vincenzo: 'profit is the maximization of human flourishing' stopped him cold
summary: Founder and STEM education builder Carlos De Vincenzo recaps Startup Day Seattle. Eric's redefinition of profit landed first thing in the morning.
blockquote: The day opened with Todd Bishop (GeekWire) interviewing Eric Ries — author of The Lean Startup — on his new book, Incorruptible. His book's argument: profit is the maximization of human flourishing. That framing stopped me cold. Mine is on the way, and I can't wait to dig in.
